---
name: Security reporting guidance
about: Read SECURITY.md before submitting any vulnerability details
---

Do not report vulnerabilities through this public form. Once the repository is public, use GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting at Security → Advisories → Report a vulnerability, as described in [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md). If unavailable, wait and keep sensitive details private. Never include credentials, personal data or private runtime exports. No separate contact channel is provided.
